_comment: Tests Node 9 wrap-up routing: follow-up request handling, CLEAR DECLINE end_call contract, plain-affirmative gate, and correct routing table intent selection.

scenarios.name: CLEAR DECLINE — farewell must call end_call in same turn as goodbye

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
No, that's all. Thanks so much!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a brief goodbye AND calls end_call in the same response turn. FAIL if: agent says goodbye without calling end_call, or calls end_call without any spoken farewell, or produces a second farewell on a subsequent turn.

scenarios.name: GRG-1 — goodbye already spoken, end_call never fired, no new caller message: retry silently, do NOT re-speak

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
No, that's good. Thank you very much.
Thanks for calling, bye.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks NOTHING (zero spoken text) and calls end_call only. FAIL if: agent re-speaks any goodbye/farewell text, or calls universal_router (with any intent, including wrap_up) instead of or in addition to end_call, or asks another question. This reproduces a live incident (conv_9001m0eb1vavf30tkr2wz34kfjqf) where an ElevenLabs mid-node model failover split the goodbye and end_call across two turns, the retry called universal_router intent="wrap_up" instead of end_call, and a subsequent turn re-spoke the goodbye a second time.

scenarios.name: GRG-3 — goodbye spoken, retry misfired as universal_router wrap_up (self-loop re-entry), no caller message since: must silently end_call, never re-speak

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
No, that's great. Thank you very much.
You're welcome. Thanks for calling, bye.
Tool result: {"intent": "wrap_up", "status": "success", "message": "Routed successfully", "reschedule_mode": "", "reschedule_offer_pending": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks NOTHING (zero spoken text) and calls end_call only. FAIL if: agent re-speaks any goodbye/farewell text (e.g. 'You're welcome' or 'Thanks for calling' again), asks 'Can I help with anything else?' again, or calls universal_router again instead of end_call. This reproduces a live incident: PART 2 of the goodbye turn misfired as universal_router intent='wrap_up' instead of end_call, which routed back into this same node (wrap_up's own destination) with a wrap_up tool result now sitting in history between the goodbye and this turn — that intervening tool result must NOT be read as a fresh legitimate entry or reset the GOODBYE-ALREADY-SPOKEN RETRY GUARD; the caller heard the goodbye twice in the live call because the agent re-ran CLASSIFY THE REPLY instead of catching this.

scenarios.name: GRG-2 — goodbye already spoken, caller replies again before end_call fires: guard must NOT fire, normal logic resumes

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
No thanks, bye.
Thanks for calling, bye.
Oh wait, actually — can I also check if you take Medicare?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: the GOODBYE-ALREADY-SPOKEN RETRY GUARD does NOT fire (a new caller message has arrived since the goodbye), and the agent instead routes the Medicare question normally (info_pivot with return_node="9", per the routing table), NOT end_call and NOT a re-spoken goodbye. FAIL if: agent calls end_call without addressing the new question, or re-speaks a goodbye, or ignores the new caller message.

scenarios.name: DA-1 — bare 'No.' is CLEAR DECLINE, never NO-PROGRESS SILENCE

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
No.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a brief goodbye AND calls end_call in the same response turn (CLEAR DECLINE — 'no' is the farewell word). FAIL if: agent says 'I'm not able to hear a clear response...' (the NO-PROGRESS SILENCE canned phrase), asks 'Hello, are you still there?', or otherwise treats this one-word real answer as silence/no-progress. A single short word that actually answers the question is a substantive reply, not dead air.

scenarios.name: DA-2 — NO-PROGRESS SILENCE second consecutive turn must speak goodbye AND call end_call together

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Hello, are you still there?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: this is the second consecutive no-progress turn with no substantive reply in between, so the agent speaks exactly 'I'm not able to hear a clear response, so I'll let you go for now — feel free to call back anytime, bye.' AND calls end_call in the same response. FAIL if: the agent speaks the goodbye phrase without calling end_call (leaving the call hanging), calls end_call without speaking, or asks 'Are you still there?' a second time instead of ending the call.

scenarios.name: PLAIN AFFIRMATIVE — 'yes' alone must not trigger routing

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Yes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks exactly 'What can I help you with?' with no tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router with any intent, or ends the call, or asks 'Can I help with anything else?' again.

scenarios.name: Practitioner availability at wrap-up — wrap_new_known not info_pivot

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Has Maia got any more appointments available on Monday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_new_known' with payload practitioner_preference='Maia' and timeframe_raw='Monday', in the same turn. FAIL if: intent='info_pivot' is used, agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase before routing, omits the filler phrase, or intent='wrap_new_unknown' when appointment_type_id is set.

scenarios.name: Follow-up booking request — routes to wrap_new_unknown not wrap_up

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Actually, can I book a remedial massage as well?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_new_unknown', in the same turn. FAIL if: intent='wrap_new_known' is used (different service from appointment_type), agent says 'Sure!' and then ends the call, asks a clarification question before routing, or omits the filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Reschedule of appointment just made — wrap_reschedule not cancel_intent

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Yeah, actually I need to move that appointment I just made to next week.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_reschedule', in the same turn. FAIL if: intent='cancel_intent' is used, intent='wrap_modify' is used instead of wrap_reschedule, agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase before routing, or omits the filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Vague booking request — route immediately, never ask clarifying questions

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Can you give me an appointment slot?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router with intent='wrap_new_known' (appointment_type_id is set) or intent='wrap_new_unknown' (appointment_type_id is 'none'), in the same turn. FAIL if: agent asks 'Are you looking for X again, or something different?' or any other clarifying question, handles availability/booking itself, or omits the filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Sure + farewell compound — 'Sure, thanks' must be treated as CLEAR DECLINE

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Sure, thanks — that's all.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent treats this as CLEAR DECLINE (farewell word 'thanks' present), speaks a brief goodbye, AND calls end_call in the same turn. FAIL if: agent interprets 'Sure' as a PLAIN AFFIRMATIVE and asks 'What can I help you with?' — the farewell word 'thanks' overrides the plain affirmative.

scenarios.name: Bare 'change that appointment' with no service named — defaults to wrap_reschedule

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Yeah, I need to change that appointment, please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_reschedule', in the same turn. FAIL if: intent='wrap_modify' is used — the caller has not named a different service or appointment type, only 'change that appointment', so this must default to wrap_reschedule — or the filler phrase is omitted.

scenarios.name: True wrap_modify — caller explicitly names a different service

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Actually can you change that to a remedial massage instead of the consult?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_modify', in the same turn. FAIL if: intent='wrap_reschedule' or 'wrap_new_unknown' is used instead — the caller explicitly named a different service ('remedial massage instead of the consult'), which is the wrap_modify case — or the filler phrase is omitted.

scenarios.name: POST-CANCEL reschedule offer — bare 'Perfect' must route to wrap_reschedule, not end the call

history.content: I've cancelled your appointment. Can I reschedule that for you now?
Perfect.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_reschedule' in the same turn, no end_call. FAIL if: agent treats 'Perfect' as CLEAR DECLINE and speaks a goodbye + calls end_call — this was the exact regression this scenario was added to catch — or the filler phrase is omitted.

scenarios.name: POST-CANCEL reschedule offer — 'That works' must route to wrap_reschedule

history.content: I've cancelled your appointment. Can I reschedule that for you now?
That works, yeah.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_reschedule', in the same turn. FAIL if: agent asks a clarifying question, ends the call, fails to call universal_router, or omits the filler phrase.

scenarios.name: ENTRY GUARD — node entry with no caller message must immediately ask closing question

history.content: STBA Members only on Saturday, August 8 at 10 AM. You'll be visiting our Sports Therapy By Andy clinic. See you then! Please contact the clinic to cancel your previous appointment.
Tool result: {"intent": "wrap_up", "status": "success", "reschedule_mode": "", "reschedule_offer_pending": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent immediately asks 'Can I help with anything else?' with no filler phrase before it, and no tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent says 'Just a sec.' or any other filler phrase without a tool call following; FAIL if agent calls any tool on entry; FAIL if agent says nothing.

scenarios.name: ENTRY GUARD — pre-transition farewell must NOT be treated as a reply to CLOSING_QUESTION

history.content: Wonderful Thomas! You're confirmed with Cameron for Acupuncture (Initial) on Friday, August 28 at 9 AM. You'll be visiting our Balmain clinic. See you then!
No that's all, thanks.
Tool result: {"intent": "wrap_up", "status": "success", "reschedule_mode": "", "reschedule_offer_pending": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent's response on entering node 9 is exactly 'Can I help with anything else?' with no tool call, no goodbye, no end_call — the farewell word in the caller's PRIOR message (spoken to the node that transitioned here, before node 9 asked anything) does not count as a reply to CLOSING_QUESTION, because node 9 has not asked it yet. FAIL if: agent speaks a goodbye and calls end_call on this turn (treating the caller's earlier farewell as CLEAR DECLINE); FAIL if agent says anything other than the exact closing question; FAIL if agent calls any tool this turn.

scenarios.name: Name correction at wrap-up — calls leave_message with correction note, no wrap_up loop

history.content: Perfect Jayda! I've cancelled your July 27 appointment and booked your return massage with Georgia for Monday August 3rd at 5 PM. Can I help with anything else?
No, it was for Celine, not Jayda.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent apologizes briefly ('Apologies about that' or similar), speaks one filler phrase, calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with a payload that includes a message_body referencing the name correction (Celine / Jayda or 'wrong name' / 'correct patient'), speaks the tool result, then asks CLOSING_QUESTION. FAIL if: agent says 'Got it, I'll make sure that's updated to Celine' or any other promise to directly update the booking without calling a tool; FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' after leave_message (would loop); FAIL if agent calls end_call before asking CLOSING_QUESTION.

scenarios.name: Third-party same-service booking after completion — wrap_new_known not wrap_new_unknown

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', booking_completed='true'
Wonderful! I've confirmed your Standard Appointment with Mark on Wednesday at 4 PM. Can I help with anything else?
Do you have a spare appointment at five PM for my mother?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_new_known' with payload including booking_for='other' and timeframe_raw='five PM', in the same turn. The service is the same (Standard Appointment) — caller named no different service type, so this is wrap_new_known not wrap_new_unknown. FAIL if: intent='wrap_new_unknown' is used; FAIL if intent='wrap_new_known' but booking_for or timeframe_raw is missing from payload; FAIL if agent says 'she would need to call directly' or any refusal; FAIL if the filler phrase is omitted.

scenarios.name: send-details: caller asks for booking confirmation only by text

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: appointment_type='Initial Consultation', appointment_date='Mon 4 Aug', appointment_time='2:30 PM', appointment_type_id='1234567890', business_name='Caloundra', details_sent=''
Can I help with anything else?
Can you text me my booking details?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='send_details_to_caller' with payload detail_type='booking' and includes appointment_type, appointment_date, appointment_time, business_name from the DVs. FAIL if: detail_type='address' is used (caller did not ask for address); FAIL if detail_type='both' is used; FAIL if appointment details (appointment_type, appointment_date, appointment_time) are absent from payload.

scenarios.name: send-details: caller asks for address only by text

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Could you send me the clinic address by text?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='send_details_to_caller' with payload detail_type='address'. FAIL if: detail_type='booking' or 'both' is used; FAIL if agent includes appointment_type or appointment_date unnecessarily.

scenarios.name: send-details: caller asks for BOTH booking details AND address — matches original failing call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: appointment_type='Initial Consultation', appointment_date='Mon 4 Aug', appointment_time='2:30 PM', appointment_type_id='1234567890', business_name='Caloundra', details_sent=''
I can send you the address by text to the number you're calling from. Would that help?
Yeah, the address and the booking that I booked.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='send_details_to_caller' with payload detail_type='both' and includes appointment_type, appointment_date, appointment_time, business_name from the DVs. FAIL if: detail_type='address' is used (caller explicitly asked for the booking too); FAIL if detail_type='booking' is used (caller also asked for address); FAIL if appointment details are absent from payload.

scenarios.name: details-ack: first delivery speaks message and calls details_ack in the same turn

history.content: Can you check when my appointment is?
Checking that now, one moment.
[universal_router intent=details response]: {"success": true, "message": "It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at 2 PM.", "patient_lookup_done": "true"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: this response contains BOTH the spoken message field verbatim ('It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at 2 PM.') AND a details_ack tool call — both in the same turn (CHECK 2 / MANDATORY PART 1+2). FAIL if: only one of the two appears, or the agent calls universal_router intent='details' again instead of details_ack.

scenarios.name: details-ack: must not fire a second time once already completed (DV correctly reads true)

history.content: Can you check when my appointment is?
Checking that now, one moment.
[universal_router intent=details response]: {"success": true, "message": "It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at 2 PM.", "patient_lookup_done": "true"}
It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at two PM.
[details_ack response]: {"details_delivered": "true"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: this response does NOT call details_ack again — it either produces zero spoken output and silently calls universal_router intent='wrap_up', or otherwise makes no tool call. FAIL if: the agent calls details_ack a second time — a completed details_ack tool call already exists immediately before this turn with no caller message in between, so re-calling it is the exact multi-firing bug this scenario protects against (live Bob Ward Physiotherapy call, 2026-08-07: details_ack fired 2-4 times in a row with no caller turn between calls).

scenarios.name: details-ack: must not fire a second time even if details_delivered DV still reads stale/empty

history.content: Can you check when my appointment is?
Checking that now, one moment.
[universal_router intent=details response]: {"success": true, "message": "It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at 2 PM.", "patient_lookup_done": "true"}
It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at two PM.
[details_ack response]: {"details_delivered": "true"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: this response does NOT call details_ack again, even though the {{details_delivered}} DV in this probe is deliberately left NOT true (simulating DV-propagation lag one turn behind the completed tool call visible in history) — a completed details_ack tool call is already visible in conversation history, and the DETAILS_ACK FIRES AT MOST ONCE rule scans history, not just the DV, before deciding whether to call it. FAIL if: the agent calls details_ack again because {{details_delivered}} reads as not-true — this is the DV-lag failure mode this scenario specifically protects against.

scenarios.name: details-ack: caller follow-up after ack uses APPOINTMENT FOLLOW-UP LOCK, not a fresh details lookup

history.content: Can you check when my appointment is?
Checking that now, one moment.
[universal_router intent=details response]: {"success": true, "message": "It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at 2 PM.", "patient_lookup_done": "true"}
It looks like your appointment was scheduled for this Thursday at two PM.
[details_ack response]: {"details_delivered": "true"}
Do I have anything else booked?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent recalls from the already-delivered message (one appointment mentioned) and says something like 'I've checked and that's the only upcoming appointment on your account — would you like to book one?' with no tool call. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='details' again, or calls details_ack again, or claims to have no record of any appointment (contradicting the message already delivered).

scenarios.name: ENTRY GUARD — no context narration after spoken line (OUTPUT CONTRACT)

history.content: I can see one upcoming appointment on your account — that's Monday the seventeenth at one forty PM.
{"details_delivered": "true"}
{"intent": "wrap_up", "status": "success"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says exactly "Can I help with anything else?" and nothing else — no additional sentences, no context narration, no summary of prior turns, no mention of details_ack or appointment details, no tool call. FAIL if: agent produces any text after "Can I help with anything else?" — specifically if it adds text like "The user has received the appointment details and the details_ack tool has been called." or any similar internal-state narration.

scenarios.name: WRAP VOCAB — add-on different service must emit wrap_new_unknown, never book_intent

history.content: Wonderful! Noam Sonnenfeld is confirmed with Imagin for Return Appointment (Standard) on Tuesday, August 11 at 10 AM.
Can I help with anything else?
Can I book an add-on red light therapy after Noam's appointment tomorrow?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks exactly one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router with intent="wrap_new_unknown" (a different service is named). FAIL if: intent is book_intent, confirm_service, confirm_time, or availability; or the agent calls smart_voice_agent; or the agent asks which service before routing; or the agent offers or checks times itself.

scenarios.name: WRAP VOCAB — same-service rebook must emit wrap_new_known

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Yeah actually, can I book another one for my friend as well?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router with intent="wrap_new_known" including booking_for="other" in the payload. FAIL if: intent is book_intent or wrap_new_unknown; or the agent calls smart_voice_agent; or the agent asks a clarifying question before routing.

scenarios.name: WRAP VOCAB — reschedule request must route, not be executed in-node

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Can you move Noam's osteo to 1pm so the red light one lines up right after?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router with intent="wrap_reschedule". FAIL if: the agent calls smart_voice_agent with intent=reschedule, performs the reschedule itself, computes or states new appointment times, or confirms any time change in spoken output.

scenarios.name: WRAP VOCAB — reschedule of BOTH appointments booked this call must route in one call, not per-appointment

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Move them both an hour later.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router intent="wrap_reschedule" exactly once, with no appointment_date/appointment_time/practitioner_id/business_id in the payload — it does not compute 'an hour later' into an exact time itself. FAIL if: the agent calls universal_router intent="reschedule" (not wrap_reschedule) for either appointment, makes more than one tool call this turn, computes or states new appointment times itself, or asks which appointment before routing.

scenarios.name: WM-1 — implicit patient-status correction after new/initial booking must route wrap_modify with patient_status

history.content: Great Diane! I have you scheduled with Kim on Saturday, August 22 at 10 AM for Initial Acupuncture Appointment. You'll be visiting our Wauchope practice. See you then!
Can I help with anything else?
Yeah, it's not an initial. I've seen Kim before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router intent='wrap_modify' with patient_status='existing' in the payload. FAIL if it routes to intent='leave_message' (the wrong-person SPECIAL CASE), asks a clarifying question first, calls smart_voice_agent directly, or omits patient_status from the payload.

scenarios.name: WM-2 — explicit replacement type named still routes wrap_modify (regression check)

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Actually can you change it to a follow-up, not the initial consult

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router intent='wrap_modify'. FAIL if it routes to wrap_reschedule, wrap_new_known, wrap_new_unknown, or leave_message, or asks a clarifying question before routing.

scenarios.name: WM-3 — wrong-person/name correction is NOT a wrap_modify type correction (exclusion check)

history.content: Can I help with anything else?
Actually, that appointment was for Celine, not Jayda — can you fix that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent apologises and calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with the corrected name in the payload, per the wrong-person SPECIAL CASE — NOT intent='wrap_modify'. FAIL if it routes to wrap_modify (this is an identity correction, not an appointment-type correction) or calls intent='wrap_up' after leave_message.

scenarios.name: Third-party booking with practitioner AND timing stated in one message — both must land in payload

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: appointment_type_id='1701928805083391378', appointment_type='Acupuncture (Initial)', booking_completed='true'
Perfect Thomas! I've booked your Acupuncture (Initial) with Brendan for Wednesday, August 19 at 10 AM. See you then!
Can I help with anything else?
Can I help with anything else?
book another for my friend after mine with the same practitioner

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls universal_router intent='wrap_new_known' with a payload that includes ALL THREE of: booking_for='other', practitioner_preference (naming the same practitioner just booked, e.g. 'Brendan' or an equivalent same-practitioner reference), AND timeframe_raw capturing the caller's stated timing dependency (e.g. 'after mine', 'right after mine', or an equivalent phrase preserving the caller's own adjacency wording — do not paraphrase it away to something generic like 'later' or drop it). FAIL if: intent is anything other than wrap_new_known; FAIL if practitioner_preference is included but timeframe_raw is omitted (this is the specific regression being tested — a real live call captured practitioner_preference='Brendan' but dropped the 'after mine' timing constraint entirely); FAIL if the agent asks a clarifying question before routing instead of passing both stated constraints through.

scenarios.name: Not-found first turn (via Node 9) — appointment_lookup_failed drives a silent CHECK 2, agent never speaks 'have you booked before' at all

history.content: Actually, can you also confirm my next appointment before we finish up?
One moment.

{"intent": "details", "message": "I couldn't find your details in our system. Have you booked with us before?", "error": "patient_not_found", "patient_lookup_done": "true", "appointment_lookup_failed": "true", "appointment_lookup_intent": "details"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: This node's own file explicitly carves out that intent='details'/'details_past' are answered here (not delegated to Node 1) — so it inherits the same shared PATIENT APPOINTMENT LOOKUP not-found handling from system_prompt.txt. PASS if: this is the agent's very first turn after the tool result (no prior details_ack, no prior speech) and appointment_lookup_failed is 'true' in the result, so CHECK 2's appointment_lookup_failed branch fires — agent produces ZERO spoken output and calls the details_ack tool (called_number, caller_id) in this same turn, rather than speaking the old ambiguous 'Have you booked with us before?' message (that wording collides with Node 2's own new/existing-patient gate question). An expression edge on appointment_lookup_failed=='true' handles the actual transition to the appointment-lookup-recovery node outside this turn — this node must not attempt its own wrap-up routing table logic on this turn. FAIL if: agent speaks 'Have you booked with us before?' or any paraphrase of the not-found message; FAIL if: agent asks the caller anything at all this turn; FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='details' again instead of details_ack; FAIL if: no tool call is made this turn; FAIL if: agent evaluates the normal wrap-up routing table instead of the appointment lookup CHECK 2 branch.

scenarios.name: TPR-1 — caller asks to hand their existing appointment to a third party: wrap_new_known, never wrap_modify

history.content: One moment. I can see one upcoming appointment on your account — that's this Monday at nine thirty AM.
Can I help with anything else?
My appointment, can I change it so my boyfriend can have that appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router with intent="wrap_new_known", payload containing booking_for="other" (and family_member_name if a name or relationship word was given). FAIL if: intent is wrap_modify, wrap_reschedule, or cancel_intent — all three treat this as a change to the CALLER's own booking and carry their already-confirmed date and time forward, which books the third party into a slot that was never checked for them (and is still occupied by the caller). Also FAIL if the agent asks a clarifying question before routing, states or confirms a specific date/time for the third party, or asks for the third party's phone number — this node routes only.

scenarios.name: TPR-2 — same-caller type correction still routes wrap_modify (exclusion must not overreach)

history.content: You're booked in for Monday at nine thirty AM with Janelle.
Can I help with anything else?
Actually that should be the initial consult, I've never been in before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase and calls universal_router with intent="wrap_modify", payload containing patient_status="new". FAIL if: intent is wrap_new_known, wrap_new_unknown, or wrap_reschedule. No third party is mentioned anywhere in this conversation, so the wrap_modify row's THIRD-PARTY EXCLUSION must not fire — this is the ordinary same-caller appointment-type correction that row exists for, and it must keep working unchanged.

scenarios.name: ENTRY GUARD — silence nudge on first entry must still ask closing question, not treat as mid-wait silence

history.content: Wonderful Carmela! I've cancelled your Wednesday, September nine appointment at ten thirty AM and you're confirmed with Zena for Chiropractic Standard Adjustment on Friday, September eighteen at twelve PM. One moment.
Tool result: {"intent": "wrap_up", "status": "success", "reschedule_mode": "", "reschedule_offer_pending": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent's response is exactly 'Can I help with anything else?' with no tool call — this is the agent's first opportunity to speak in node 9, CLOSING_QUESTION has never been asked yet, so the SPECIAL CASES silence rule ('Silence 5+ seconds after your question') does not apply — that rule requires CLOSING_QUESTION to already have been spoken by this node. FAIL if: agent says 'Hello, are you still there?' or any other silence check-in phrase instead of the closing question; FAIL if agent says anything other than the exact closing question; FAIL if agent calls any tool this turn. The caller then said 'Yes', the agent asked a generic 'What can I help you with?' instead of the scripted closing question, more silence followed, and the caller hung up (Client disconnected) without ever hearing 'Can I help with anything else?' or the call ending via end_call.

FAIL if: preferred_days is '1,2' (the excluded days sent literally instead of converted to the inclusion list); FAIL if preferred_days is omitted entirely; FAIL if the agent re-asks 'What's your name for the waitlist?'; FAIL if the agent asks a clarifying question before calling the tool.
